items.title: AstraZeneca pays up to $1.5bn to license Dizal Pharma’s lung cancer drug
items.summary: In licensing Zegfrovy, AstraZeneca has gained an already approved asset, with a label expansion potentially on the horizon.

items.title: Novartis and Chai Discovery collaborate on antibody identification
items.summary: Novartis has entered a collaboration with Chai Discovery to advance the use of AI in the identification of therapeutic antibodies.

items.title: Cellares and Sonoma partner to automate cell therapy manufacturing
items.summary: Cellares and Sonoma Biotherapeutics have partnered to automate the manufacturing of the latter’s SBT-77-7101 programme using the Cellares Cell Shuttle platform.

items.title: Is your quality system built for 2026’s new regulatory reality?
items.summary: Delve into the current compliance landscape for life sciences manufacturers and the vulnerabilities found in legacy quality systems.

items.title: Germany approves healthcare costs overhaul despite significant pharma opposition
items.summary: There are a range of cost-containment measures across the bill that will create a significant healthcare system shakeup.
